title: [SOA]: Bugbash for releases 28.x - Contact unable to find due to Qasim map to Megan, different names
summary: Fixes Sales Order Agent contact lookup and reply routing when a sender's email is mapped to a different contact. Lookup, filtering and recipient resolution now consider E-Mail 2 and the task contact override, and replies go to the mapped contact's primary email in the same thread.
key_points: Contact lookup resolves the contact stored in SOA Task Contact Override for the active input message
Lookup, security filtering and known-sender checks consider both E-Mail and E-Mail 2
Replies stay in the original thread but are addressed to the mapped contact, keeping CC and BCC
New Contact List OnBeforeFindRecord event, with the subscriber bound only during SOA sessions
Agent instructions treat the mapped contact as authoritative instead of asking for help over the mismatch
